newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun buys control of Venezuelan firm.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun buys control of Venezuelan firm.

text.p: British insurer Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc said on Monday it bought a controlling interest in Royal Caribe of Venezuela.
The UK firm said it bought at auction the shareholding in Royal Caribe previously held by Venezuelan state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade.
Royal & Sun said the purchase of the government's stake raised its holding to over 50 percent from its previous level of about 40 percent.
The company said it paid less than 0.5 percent of its pro forma net asset value of 6.26 billion stg at June 30 for the additional stake.
The UK firm subsequently bought other shareholders' stakes, increasing its interest in Royal Caribe to nearly 100 percent.

"Our group has been involved with Royal Caribe for many years, and we know it to be a well-managed and forward-looking company which fits well with the group's desire to build its worldwide network," Royal & Sun said in a statement.
